gloss: official residence (of a head of state)

definitions.gloss: official residence (of a prime minister, governor, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The official residence provided to a high-ranking government official. In Japan, most commonly refers to the Prime Minister's Official Residence.

examples.japanese: {首相|しゅしょう}{官邸|かんてい}で{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A press conference was held at the Prime Minister's official residence.

examples.japanese: {官邸|かんてい}の{前|まえ}にデモ{隊|たい}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Demonstrators gathered in front of the official residence.

examples.japanese: {官邸|かんてい}は{緊急|きんきゅう}{対策|たいさく}{本部|ほんぶ}を{設置|せっち}し、{情報収集|じょうほうしゅうしゅう}に{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: The official residence established an emergency task force and gathered information.

notes:
{官邸|かんてい} combines {官|かん} (government, official) and {邸|てい} (mansion, residence).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首相|しゅしょう}{官邸|かんてい} (Prime Minister's Official Residence)
- {知事|ちじ}{公邸|こうてい} (governor's official residence — note: {公邸|こうてい} is used for governors)
- {官邸|かんてい}{筋|すじ} (sources close to the PM's office)

USAGE:
In news media, {官邸|かんてい} by itself usually refers to the {首相|しゅしょう}{官邸|かんてい}. It can also be used metonymically to mean the prime minister or the prime minister's staff, similar to how "the White House" refers to the US president's administration.
